title: A starter food keeps its capital in a step: Chicken breast
boardTitle: B169: a starter food keeps its capital in a step

opportunity.from: The full walkthrough run of 0.3.193, 25 November 2026: recipe-photos fails the same way on main 0.3.192. Coach Milan 15:55: its own ticket, first thing next.
opportunity.job: Read a recipe's steps with the foods I have.
opportunity.kind: Looks broken: a basic food named with a capital in the middle of a sentence.
opportunity.why_now: Accounts from the pilot still hold the first starter foods, so their steps say Chicken breast; and a walkthrough that fails hides the next failure.

problem: The app's first starter foods (Chicken breast, cooked, Rice, cooked, Oats, with the line typical values, check your pack) were saved as read from a label. Since B163 (0.3.189) a name read from a label stays as printed, so a step says Fold in 100 g Chicken breast. A food from today's basic foods says chicken breast. B163 went out with Light checks, so recipe-photos did not run and it stayed unseen for four releases.
story: When I read a recipe's steps, I want a basic food named the same way whether it came with the app or from the food table, so that the steps read like a recipe.
now: Step 2 of a recipe with the starter chicken: Fold in 100 g Chicken breast and cook slowly. The same in Edit recipe's steps. A pack, Frischer Blätterteig, as printed.
proposed: A food with the starter foods' line (typical values, check your pack) counts as a basic food: its name in a step is in small letters, chicken breast. A pack keeps its name as printed, as B163. Nothing saved changes: the name comes from the food each time the step is shown.
looked_at: Change only the walkthrough's test food to a food from the food table, as B163 did in five walkthroughs (option B, 15:58): not chosen, 15:59: the old starter foods would keep their capitals on real phones.
short: A starter food is a basic food: small letters in a step, chicken breast; release 0.3.194

ac.title: A starter food in small letters
ac.text: Given a recipe with Chicken breast, cooked, one of the first starter foods, when I read its steps, then step 2 reads Fold in 100 g chicken breast and cook slowly

ac.title: Everywhere the steps show
ac.text: Given the same recipe, when I open Edit recipe or Start cooking, then the step says chicken breast too

ac.title: A pack as printed
ac.text: Given Frischer Blätterteig from a barcode in the same recipe, when I read the steps, then it reads Frischer Blätterteig, as now

ac.title: recipe-photos as written
ac.text: Given recipe-photos.cjs, when it runs on this build, then R13a, R13b, R11 and R13 pass with the walkthrough unchanged

unchanged: B163: a pack's name as printed, a decimal comma kept, a name cut only at a comma with a space.
The list under Edit recipe's steps names each food as saved.
checks: Light: one function, the names in the steps (shortName in src/steps.ts). The unit tests with a new one for a starter food; the build; recipe-photos for AC4 and a new check in step-names for AC1 to AC3; and every walkthrough with steps, as for B163, about 33 and 10 minutes. No new words on screen.
details: shortName in src/steps.ts: a food with brand typical values, check your pack (TYPICAL in src/pilot.ts; repairState turns the older generic, check your package into it) counts as a basic food.
The pictures: before from main, 0.3.193; new from a scratch build of main with the change, not committed. The recipe holds two starter foods, eggs and chicken, and one pack.
